thread:
maria: Hey team — I pushed a first-pass release note + internal announce draft here: https://docs.google.com/xyz. Need quick eyeballs on change window wording, pinned version, and rollback blurb. Can we lock those by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: reading now. main question: are we pinning to model v2.1.4-quant or fallback v2.0.9? If traffic drops, do we auto-fallback or manual?

leo: recommend auto-fallback to v2.0.9 for latency SLOs, but require alerting + SRE manual approve for rollforward. Add thresholds: 10% error rate for 5m or median p95 > 800ms.

maria: noted. I'll add thresholds and a short rollback steps section. Also planning change window: Fri 23:00–01:00 UTC (2hr). Any objections?

ops: that's ok for APAC, but US-east has higher peak at that hour. propose Sat 02:00–04:00 UTC instead. @maria?

maria: can we make the public tilt to Sat 02:00 and keep canary Fri 23:00 for small audience? That reduces blast risk.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — canary v2.1.4 -> 5% traffic at Fri 23:00 UTC. Rollback policy: auto-fallback disabled. Manual rollback window open for 60min. (deploy-id: db-2026-4790)

eve (docs): I'll prep the internal blurb with short bullet list and snippet for embeddable changelog. Will include a "what to monitor" checklist.

sam: suggest adding a short runbook snippet in the RN. Example:

```
If p95 > 800ms for 5m:
1) throttle new sessions
2) revert routing to v2.0.9
3) escalate to #eng-oncall
```

leo: +1. Also add contact matrix — who is primary oncall, who is backup.

maria: updated doc, pinned version field to "v2.1.4 (pinned for release)". Link: https://docs.google.com/xyz?updated. Standby rota: @ops (00:00-03:00 UTC), @leo (backup). Eve will publish internal announce at T-30m.

ops: I'll be on standby Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please add my number to the blurb. :phone: 

maria: thanks all — locking RN at 21:30 UTC. Deploybot will post canary cue at 23:00. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
